name: starter
description: A small, opinionated user-level setup: ask-before-assuming and verify-before-done rules injected at session start, a review gate, an opt-in cycle (gather, plan, plan review, build, code review, probe) that hands off through a plan file to role agents that fix model and effort (reader, writer, reviewer), a /phase pane, a visual-plan skill, safe worktree cleanup, and a monthly review with optional context7 MCP server.
